hypothesis: Linear minGRU or ParaGRU retains near-native held-out CE after fivefold exposure with lower CPU cost
primary_metric: Final CE in nats per2048-BPE token on16384 reused validation targets
success_rule: Exploratory candidate if CE<=native+0.03 and training CPU speedup>=1.25, all checks/budgets pass; otherwise no advance. Not confirmation.
futility_rule: Abort nonfinite loss/gradients, failed convergence, hash mismatch or resource cap; preserve every failure
